plan.summary: This plan adjusts the vertical positioning of SKILLS lower line and EXPERIENCE bullet points to reduce excessive gaps and detachments, consolidating skill lines into a coherent block and creating a more compact Experience section. Additionally, it rebalances the overall vertical layout to utilize space efficiently without overlap or loss of clean separation. All changes preserve content, order, and section alignment, fulfilling all required Founder feedback items.
